_comment: Tier-2 for dune::maxwell#0. Measured 2026-08-06 on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, wall time 2 s (no form is built): none of nedelec / Nedelec / hcurl / hCurl / HCurl / curl / edge / whitney is an attribute of dune.fem.space, and importing dune.fem.space.nedelec or dune.fem.space.hcurl raises ModuleNotFoundError. The space factories that DO exist were enumerated so that adding a Nedelec family upstream makes this fixture fail instead of quietly staying true: bdfm, bdm, combined, composite, dganisotropic, dglagrange, dglegendre, dgonb, finiteVolume, lagrange, lagrangehp, p1Bubble, product, rannacherTurek, raviartThomas. The proxy the shipped maxwell template uses is scalar (lagrange(order=2).dimRange == 1) and the only vector alternative is still a Lagrange element — str(lagrange(order=2, dimRange=2).ufl_element()) is '<Lagrange1 on a triangle>' — so it cannot carry the tangential-only continuity H(curl) needs. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 installs nedelec and Nedelec factories on dune.fem.space, i.e. the world in which dune-fem has grown an edge element. Both spellings are needed because the runner matches expect strings CASE-INSENSITIVELY, so with only the lowercase name installed the line 'space_has_Nedelec=False' still satisfies the expectation 'space_has_nedelec=False'. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'space_has_nedelec=False', 'dune_no_hcurl_nedelec_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
